title: Pointing Room
description: Two-room planning poker whose room-keyed cross-table live query withholds every other principal's vote until reveal, with runtime Contract re-scoping and raw-wire cross-room isolation proof.

backend.stalenessPolicy: committed review projections; regenerate with codegen

seed.note: Planning and Platform are structural room fixtures. Their inert seed owner is never used as an authorization predicate; all callable operations still require a real session principal.

headless.toolchain: node>=22 and the prebuilt local Snapback runtime

contract.toolchain: bun, Exact registry packages, and headless Chrome

headless: two independently minted sessions resolve to different principals
principal A can see its own vote before reveal
principal B's raw liveTally subscription bytes contain value:null and not A's vote before reveal
a Platform vote never appears in principal B's Planning subscription bytes or rows
principal B's raw WebSocket bytes contain A's vote after reveal
late voting refuses with application code ROUND_REVEALED
contract: compiled Contract root mounts against a sessions-mode backend
activeRoomId re-keys liveRound, liveTally, and presence without remounting
server inspection shows both predecessor query subscription ids disappear and two successor ids establish on every switch
Planning and Platform render only their own topic and tally rows after re-scoping
participant cards render the nullable server value directly with null mapped to '?'

notClaiming: hosted auth or hosted ephemeral rooms
